summary: Our Club was the lead host club for District MIPS (Model Indian Parliamentary Session) held on 11th October from 9 am onwards as Grant Government Medical College.
description:
Our Club was the lead host club for District MIPS (Model Indian Parliamentary Session) held on 11th October from 9 am onwards as Grant Government Medical College. The engaging session of District 3141 MIPS was attended by over 200 students.

The session provided students with an enriching experience of the Indian Parliamentary process through lively debates, thought-provoking discussions, and an engaging Question Hour on the Finance Bill. It offered the young participants an opportunity to experience the workings of Parliament, express their views, and develop their critical thinking and public speaking skills.

As part of the initiative, every student received a booklet featuring the “Thuko Mat” advertisement, reinforcing the message shared through the campaign.

The event was attended by Youth Director Sonal Pangoriya, who participated as a Judge.

Lead Host charges Rs 60,000/-.
